text:
alex: Starting a config-only push for small-latency model-group at tonight's change window (23:00-00:30 PT). Purpose: reduce queuing delays for short queries. No model binaries will change.

alex: Diff summary: batch.max_wait_ms 40 -> 20, route.weight_floor 0.05 -> 0.10, concurrency.soft_limit 6 -> 8. Will deploy canary -> 20% -> 60% -> full.

priya: +1 from product. Confirmed no evaluation-needed for quality since model identical. We'll monitor token cost impact.

deploy-bot: [queued] config-deploy config-v1.9.3 -> canary (target=small-latency, window=23:00-00:30 PT) by alex  runbook: https://go/releases/config-v1.9.3-runbook 

alex: Ops notes for oncall: if any tenant shows error_rate > 0.4% or P99 increases by >40ms vs baseline, trigger rollback. Also watch memory pressure due to increased concurrency.

sylvie: Infra note: will pre-warm + keep a 2-host buffer for canary. I'll keep an eye on RPC latencies.

deploy-bot: [started] canary at 23:05 PT  5% traffic -> hosts: r-inf-can-07/08

infra-watch: Canary healthy after 6m. P95 -2ms, P99 +4ms. No OOMs.

priya: Running smoke evals (dataset: short-queries-100) against canary. Outputs match baseline for intent and slot-filling.

alex: Moving to 20% in 8m if no flags. Anyone see red?

infra-watch: No red. Proceed.

deploy-bot: [in-progress] ramp to 20% at 23:18 PT

sylvie: At 20% we see a small uptick in tail latency for tenant 1293 (spike to 0.6% error rate, mostly transient TCP resets at edge). Opening INF-4902.

priya: Tenant 1293 flagged. Do we need to pause? What's the scope?

alex: Hold at 20% while INF-4902 is investigated. If issue is edge-level and not model-level, we can continue.

infra-watch: After edge fix, tenant 1293 errors dropped back to baseline (0.08%). No model errors.

deploy-bot: [resume] ramp to 60% at 23:34 PT

sylvie: At 60% P99 increased ~22ms compared to baseline but error-rate stable across top tenants. Memory headroom OK.

priya: Cost team: estimate token-cost diff to be ~+3% due to concurrency change. Acceptable.

alex: We'll pin this config to config-v1.9.3 in release registry and add a note to changelog: "config-v1.9.3: tighter batch max_wait, bumped routing weight floor, soft concurrency limit increase"

release-coordinator: Added changelog entry and tagged release; pinned routing policy in control plane to the new config set.

deploy-bot: [finalizing] rolling to 100% with staged steps at 23:45 / 23:55 / 00:05 PT

infra-watch: At 100% (00:06 PT): overall error_rate unchanged, P95 slightly improved, P99 within acceptable delta. However, tenant 204 flagged a recurring 502s (rate ~0.3%) tied to an edge timeout. Not model.

sylvie: We evaluated telemetry and saw no increase in model-side retry loops. Suggest keeping config live and loop in edge team for 204.

alex: Agreed. No full rollback. But we'll perform a partial rollback if any tenant exceeds error_rate threshold for >4m. Set an automated watch.

deploy-bot: [watching] auto-rollback hook enabled: trigger if any tenant error_rate > 0.4% for 4m or P99 delta > 50ms for 3m

priya: I'll schedule a 12h and 24h postmortem watch in case of late regressions and record cost delta in the release notes.

release-coordinator: 12h watch set. Added note: owners: priya, sylvie, alex. Rollback procedure documented in the runbook link.

alex: Closing thread. If anyone sees new anomalies, re-open or ping me directly. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
